expressions.name: highest_month
expressions.expr: max(extras['usage_history'], key=lambda x: x['units'])

expressions.name: fpa_amount
expressions.expr: next(c['amount'] for c in level1['charges'] if c['type'] == 'fpa')

expressions.name: late_payment_fee
expressions.expr: level1['payable_after_due_date'] - level1['payable_within_due_date']

expressions.name: current_units
expressions.expr: level1['units_consumed']

expressions.name: last_year_units
expressions.expr: next(x['units'] for x in extras['usage_history'] if x['month'] == 'Sep25')

expressions.name: diff
expressions.expr: level1['units_consumed'] - next(x['units'] for x in extras['usage_history'] if x['month'] == 'Sep25')

expressions.name: avg_units
expressions.expr: facts['usage_avg']

expressions.name: current_units
expressions.expr: level1['units_consumed']

expressions.name: summer_units
expressions.expr: sum(x['units'] for x in extras['usage_history'] if x['month'] in ['Jun25', 'Jul25', 'Aug25', 'Jun26', 'Jul26', 'Aug26'])

expressions.name: winter_units
expressions.expr: sum(x['units'] for x in extras['usage_history'] if x['month'] in ['Dec25', 'Jan26', 'Feb26'])

expressions.name: summer_avg
expressions.expr: sum(x['units'] for x in extras['usage_history'] if x['month'] in ['Jun26', 'Jul26', 'Aug26'])

expressions.name: winter_avg
expressions.expr: sum(x['units'] for x in extras['usage_history'] if x['month'] in ['Dec25', 'Jan26', 'Feb26'])

expressions.name: diff
expressions.expr: sum(x['units'] for x in extras['usage_history'] if x['month'] in ['Jun26', 'Jul26', 'Aug26']) - sum(x['units'] for x in extras['usage_history'] if x['month'] in ['Dec25', 'Jan26', 'Feb26'])

expressions.name: unpaid_bills
expressions.expr: [row for row in extras['billing_history_rows'] if row['amount_paid'] < row['amount_billed']]

expressions.name: last_3_months
expressions.expr: [x['units'] for x in extras['usage_history'][-3:]]

expressions.name: recent_change
expressions.expr: facts['usage_change_vs_last_month']

expressions.name: next_month_estimate
expressions.expr: next(x['units'] for x in extras['usage_history'] if x['month'] == 'Oct25')

expressions.name: total_annual_cost
expressions.expr: sum(row['amount_billed'] for row in extras['billing_history_rows'])

expressions.name: monthly_average_cost
expressions.expr: sum(row['amount_billed'] for row in extras['billing_history_rows']) / len(extras['billing_history_rows'])

expressions.name: last_month_bill
expressions.expr: next(row['amount_billed'] for row in extras['billing_history_rows'] if row['month'] == 'Aug26')
